metric_definitions.secondary_note: Must not silently substitute for D

alpaca_overlap.policy: Instructions were authored for this pilot and are not copied from a known Alpaca export in-repo. Exact string overlap with yahma/alpaca-cleaned is possible and must be reported before scientific claims.

selection_protocol.description: Authored fixed candidate list; exclude Stage-0 smoke instructions; take first 100 unique; Fisher–Yates with LCG seed 20261113; contiguous split discovery[0:50], validation[50:75], held_out[75:100].

dataset_audit.explicit_non_claim: Overlap remains unverified. Do not interpret empty exact_overlaps as evidence of no training-corpus overlap.

stopping_procedure.preflight: Abort if high-end projected cost exceeds authorized Stage 1 cap.
stopping_procedure.runtime_guard: Checkpoint per seed; stop if remaining work exceeds deadline/budget.
stopping_procedure.early_stop_scientific: If discovery-fold top-10 Jaccard < 0.3 for every seed, stop before held_out. Native validation |D| gate recorded before transfer interpretation.
stopping_procedure.dollars_not_account_limit: Software estimates are NOT an enforced Modal account spending limit.

workload_estimate_v2_1.explicit_non_claim: Full pilot cost is not $0.53. Screening 396×3 and damage-candidate KL dominate.

calibration_prepared_not_executed.purpose: Bounded calibration with real hooks on one seed / few instructions to refine full-scan cost; implemented but not authorized to run.

workload_estimate_v2_1.reconciliation_note: Joint instruction-level D scores on both splits = 3000 (was under-counted when held-out used only 3 primary conditions). Condition evals/split = 60.
